summary: All 3 regression fixes from iteration 6 verified. Backend: 7/7 pytest passing including new 422 test on POST /api/sync with amount_minor=0. Frontend at 390x844: sheet-workspace, sheet-account, sheet-expense, sheet-budget all render on-viewport (sheet-save y between 463-595, all inside 844px height). FAB visible at y=700. End-to-end mobile flow succeeds: create workspace 'TEST Personal' -> create account 'TEST Wallet' -> FAB opens expense sheet -> add 'TEST Coffee' 250.75 -> ledger tab shows entry -> budgets tab -> create budget 5000 -> spending tab shows content. No 'shadow*' or 'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings observed in browser console (0 warnings/errors total). Sync-error-banner not exercised (backend healthy, same as iter 6).

integration_issues.issue: testID sync-error-banner path not reachable in a healthy environment; would require induced network failure or a dev toggle. Not a bug — carried over from iter 6.

action_items: Optional: add a dev/QA toggle in SyncScreen to force a sync failure so testID sync-error-banner can be exercised in preview.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/tests/test_ledgerly_api.py originally read only EXPO_BACKEND_URL; the preview env exposes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Updated the test to fall back to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL so pytest works both locally and in preview.
BottomSheetForm cleanly branches on Platform.OS==='web' using position:'fixed' overlay pinned to viewport bottom — good fix. Same pattern applied consistently in WorkspaceSwitcher.

server.py /api/sync now wraps TransactionIn(**payload) in try/except and raises 422 with the offending event id — matches request; still not per-event isolated (first bad payload aborts the whole batch) but that's acceptable behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for regression scope; sync-error-banner path not exercised

seed_data_creation: Backend tests seed TEST_ workspace + TEST_ account + TEST_ transactions. Frontend flow seeded 'TEST Personal' workspace, 'TEST Wallet' account, 'TEST Coffee' 250.75 expense, budget 5000.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 BottomSheetForm variants render on-viewport at 390x844 (sheet-save y in [463,595]). Backend returns 422 for invalid nested transaction payload. Console clean — no shadow*/pointerEvents warnings. End-to-end flow verified. If further iterations are needed, focus on sync-error-banner path via induced failure (invalid backend URL or offline mode) and per-event isolation in /api/sync.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — regression fixes all verified.
